name: Capivara Booster v2.4.1 (Rust Edition)
notes: ## Added

- Debloater with real Windows state: the screen queries Get-AppxPackage on load and marks each package as Installed or Removed for real; removed packages get a Restore action that re-registers the app via Add-AppxPackage
- 10 new UWP packages: Copilot, Clipchamp, OneNote UWP, Camera, Alarms, Snip & Sketch, Sound Recorder plus the preinstalled Spotify, Disney+ and TikTok wrappers (25 total)

- Expanded telemetry switch: 10 scheduled tasks disabled (full CEIP: Consolidator, UsbCeip, KernelCeipTask, Uploader, Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater, StartupAppTask, Autochk Proxy, CloudExperienceHost, Feedback/DmClient) on top of DiagTrack/dmwappushservice and ad keys
## Fixed
- Driver Booster opening vendor sites: cmd start misinterpreted URLs containing & and Windows showed a "\\ not found" network path error; the browser now opens via PowerShell Start-Process
- Debloat table rebuilt in the professional style: summary chips (present/removed/total), per-row status and Restore button, Recommended preset
## PT-BR

- Debloater com estado real do Windows: a tela consulta Get-AppxPackage ao carregar e marca cada pacote como Instalado ou Removido de verdade; pacotes removidos ganham botão Restaurar que re-registra o app
- 10 pacotes novos: Copilot, Clipchamp, OneNote UWP, Camera, Alarmes, Snip & Sketch, Gravador de Voz e os wrappers pré-instalados Spotify, Disney+ e TikTok (25 no total)
- Telemetria expandida: 10 tarefas agendadas desativadas (CEIP completo) além do DiagTrack/dmwappushservice e chaves de anúncio
- Fim do popup "\\ não foi possível localizar" no Driver Booster: o site do fabricante abre via PowerShell Start-Process
- Tabela do Debloat no estilo profissional: chips de resumo, status por linha e botão Restaurar, com preset Recomendados

name: Capivara Booster v2.4.0 (Rust Edition)
notes: ## Added

- Full System Report: new dashboard button collects live telemetry (CPU model, load %, temperature via ACPI sensor, RAM usage, GPU driver and date, per-disk free space, active power plan, timer state, motherboard with exact model, BIOS and Windows build) and generates a branded PDF on the user's real Desktop (registry path, OneDrive-safe)
- Report PDF generated in pure Rust (PDF 1.4 written by hand, no external crates): Capivara Booster branded header, organized sections and repository footer
## Changed

- CI/CD build time: tauri-cli is now cached (was recompiled every run, 3-5 minutes), npm install with node_modules cache, rust-cache covering all crates and the cargo bin directory, release profile with codegen-units 16 and thin LTO (much faster linking)
## Fixed
- Release workflow failing on the manifest commit step (local Cargo.toml change blocked the checkout of main)
- Release workflow failing on npm ci (repository has no package-lock.json)
## PT-BR

- Relatório Completo: novo botão no painel coleta telemetria ao vivo (CPU com nome, carga e temperatura via sensor ACPI, RAM, driver e data da GPU, espaço livre por disco, plano de energia, estado dos timers, placa-mãe exata, BIOS e build do Windows) e gera um PDF com a marca Capivara Booster na Área de Trabalho real (caminho via registro, compatível com OneDrive)
- PDF gerado em Rust puro (PDF 1.4 escrito à mão, sem crates externas): cabeçalho com faixa Cyber Mint, seções organizadas e rodapé com o repositório

- Tempo de build no CI: tauri-cli agora é cacheado (antes recompilava a cada run, 3 a 5 minutos), npm com cache de node_modules, rust-cache cobrindo todas as crates e o cargo bin, perfil release com codegen-units 16 e LTO thin
- Fim do erro do workflow de release no commit do manifest e no npm ci
